text:
alex: Hey — quick unblock question. PR #4321 modifies CODEOWNERS for /infra/runtime. Primary owner @sam is OOO this sprint. Who can approve so we don't block the staging rollout?
marie: I can take this if we follow the proxy rules. Need explicit sign-off from an area lead (pinging @jordan).
jordan: Fine with a one-off proxy here. @marie, leave a comment on the PR that says: "approved-by: jordan (proxy for @sam)" and link to this thread. Also add a short PR description of why the change is safe.
taylor: Alternative: add a temporary line to CODEOWNERS that points to @marie for this path, but that requires a quick follow-up cleanup. I'd prefer PR-level approval comment as jordan suggested.
lee: Can someone paste the PR link and the exact files changed? want to skim quick before approving.
alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 — touches infra/runtime/owner.yaml and infra/runtime/startup.sh (small config rename). diff: ```diff -- infra/runtime/owner.yaml +owner: infra-runtime -owner: sam```
deploy-bot: merge-block: "Blocked: CODEOWNERS requires approval from infra runtime owners"
marie: skimmed. changes are ops-only and a rename. I'll approve once @jordan's comment is on the PR. Leaving a short checklist comment now.
jordan: Comment left: "approved-by: jordan (proxy for @sam) — temporary proxy to unblock staging. Follow-up: @marie to open cleanup ticket to revert proxy entry if we go that route."
marie: Approved on GitHub and added CI note. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks everyone — I'll let CI run and merge once green. tagging: @eng-platform FYI.
deploy-bot: merge-unlock: "PR 4321 unlocked for merge after required approvals"
alex: merged and kicked staging deploy. will watch logs and report back if anything pops up. :eyes:
jordan: Thanks — good call on PR-level signoff. remind the team to avoid long-lived temporary CODEOWNERS entries.
